project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 7 SPA (Athen learning platform), Supabase backend (PostgreSQL + Auth + Storage), deployed on Vercel

test_command: npm run test (vitest run). Also npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) and npm run lint (eslint .).
